basics.name: Brendan Cirillo
basics.label: Economist
basics.summary: Applied microeconomist interested in health, crime, and political economist. Currently working in the Office of Management and Budget

work.name: Office of Management and Budget
work.summary: Internal economic consultant for OMB helping across divisions to help score and finalize the President's budget.
highlights: Explored the impact of the Inflation Reduction Act's $4 billion and found no crowding out affect.
Scored individual tax policy for the President's budget.
Streamlined and improved the individual tax model for the ten-year forcast window resulting in faster and more accurate scores.

work.name: University of Missouri, Columbia
work.summary: Two different research assistant positions. One working with stochastic macroeconomic predictions and the other working on political economy projects.
highlights: Conducted macroeconomic stochastic projections for an agricultural economic model to better match the historic stochastic process.
Performed a variety of causal analysis on voting policy changes and their impact on voting, registration, and trust in elections.

volunteer.organization: The Food Bank for Central and Northeast Missouri
volunteer.summary: Coordinated with full-time staff to help onboard Missouri residents to SNAP, formerly Food Stamps.
highlights: Along with onboarding SNAP, helped the full-time staff as needed.

awards.summary: Awarded to a PhD student who demonstrates excellence in economic research and PhD coursework.
